description: Production Rust changes (plan items 1-5): preflight and measurement; dock_layout.rs constants/pure functions (LEFT_RAIL_MAX 460, rail_icon_edge, RIGHT_DOCK_FIXTURE=Snaps); outer-width storage and width-driven sidebar icons; audit layout modes + removed OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK + OM9_UI_AUDIT_RAIL_WIDTH + richer ui-receipt + CMD-focus-gated audit script (fixes the spurious 'unsupported unknown/unavailable command' text); minimal drop zone so the hidden right dock can appear by dragging. Independent of nothing; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on it.
steps: Plan item 1: copy .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/review.json to review.min-window.json and overwrite review.json with {"verdict":"PENDING","task":"m01-l3-002-left-dock-icons"}; record `git diff --cached --name-only` into .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/left-dock-measurements.md as the staged baseline; run cargo check --workspace --all-targets; add a temporary measuring test and write outer/inner rail widths, title-bar y values and scroll offset at 1280x720 and 1600x1000 into left-dock-measurements.md; reproduce the CMD error in default mode with OM9_UI_AUDIT_WINDOW=1366x680 OM9_UI_AUDIT_ZOOM=1.25 OM9_UI_AUDIT_MONITOR=1366x768 and record the cmd field.

Plan item 2: edit standalone/crates/om9-app/src/dock_layout.rs (LEFT_RAIL_MAX=460, ICON_BASE_EDGE/ICON_MIN_EDGE/ICON_MAX_EDGE, rail_icon_edge, RIGHT_DOCK_FIXTURE, RIGHT_DROP_ZONE_WIDTH, LEFT_RAIL_CHROME_PX from the measurement, header comments, pure unit tests, replace the two Layers-right unit tests with RIGHT_DOCK_FIXTURE) and src/workbench_regions.rs (compile-time NARROW_WINDOW_WIDTH assertion '>' -> '>=' with comment; dead_notes_stay_unreachable still passes unweakened).

Plan item 3: edit src/ui.rs panel closures and src/ui/chrome.rs: keep the Panel::show result, store OUTER width via sync_panel_size, add left_rail_outer_px, column_icon_edge, pub rail_icon_rects, sidebar_content_size; icon() uses column_icon_edge and records rects only for sidebar/right-dock columns; reset edge to 22 after the column so the toolbar is unchanged. Do not touch ui/layers.rs.

Plan item 4: in src/ui.rs add AuditLayoutMode + parse_audit_layout_mode (unit tested), replace the OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK block in launch_with (fail loudly if the old variable is set; user-docked-right docks RIGHT_DOCK_FIXTURE; default docks nothing), add OM9_UI_AUDIT_RAIL_WIDTH, extract dock_receipt() with the new fields (section_title_bars_px, layers_rect_px, sidebar_scroll_offset, left_rail_outer_px, left_rail_inner_px, left_icon_edge_px, left_icon_rects_in_sidebar, left_stack_content_px, right_dock_visible, right_dock_sections) and receipt["audit"], and gate the scripted CMD input in raw_input_hook on the CMD field having focus (new check 'audit CMD focus ready'; existing four check strings unchanged). Add the unit test dock_receipt_contains_the_left_stack_evidence.

Plan item 5: add right_drop_zone_rect + overlay painting while a menu drag is in progress and the right dock is hidden and the window is >= NARROW_WINDOW_WIDTH; settle_section_drag docks right when released inside the zone, shows a status line and changes nothing below 1200 pt; add the chrome.rs unit test (zone appears without reflow, release docks Snaps right, dock appears next frame, dock_menu_section(Snaps, Left) hides it, 1100 pt window shows no zone).

After every edit keep the workspace buildable; update any existing test assertion that compared the stored rail width with the inner 295 and list it (with the reason) in left-dock-measurements.md for the later doc table.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p om9-app --lib -j 1 passes including the new rail_icon_edge (anchors 240->18, 300->22, 460->34, monotone, clamped, non-finite->22), parse_audit_layout_mode, dock_receipt and drop-zone tests
LEFT_RAIL_MAX is 460, RIGHT_DOCK_MAX is 420, NARROW_WINDOW_WIDTH is still 1200 and the plan floor assertion (800 >= 460 + 320) and the dead-note assertion (1200 >= 460 + 420 + 320) compile
A fresh default frame reports left_rail outer width within 0.5 of 300 and inner = outer - LEFT_RAIL_CHROME_PX; the stored PanelState.size is the outer width
Setting the left rail to 460 makes sidebar icon rects 34 px wide and to 240 makes them 18 px wide, while toolbar icons stay 22 px; all sidebar icon rects stay inside sidebar_rect
OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK is no longer honoured (launch fails with the rename message); OM9_UI_AUDIT_LAYOUT_MODE=default docks nothing; =user-docked-right docks Snaps; any other value fails visibly
In default mode a real lap125/lap150 audit run leaves cmd without 'unsupported' and the four existing checks plus 'audit CMD focus ready' present
Releasing a dragged menu in the drop zone docks it right and the right dock appears; the last panel leaving hides it again; layers.rs is unchanged (git diff empty for that file)
verification: cd h:\OpenMatrix9; git diff --stat -- standalone/crates/om9-app/src/ui/layers.rs standalone/crates/om9-app/src/session (must be empty); git diff --cached --name-only (must equal the baseline recorded in left-dock-measurements.md)
findings:
FEAT-001 done (plan items 1-5). Verified: cargo fmt --check, check --workspace --all-targets, clippy -D warnings clean; cargo test -p om9-app -j 1 all green (lib 80 passed incl. rail_icon_edge, parse_audit_layout_mode, parse_audit_rail_width, dock_receipt_contains_the_left_stack_evidence, 2 drop-zone tests; every tests/*.rs unchanged and passing); layers.rs/session untouched; staged index hash unchanged (baseline list in .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/staged-baseline.txt). Notes: .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/left-dock-measurements.md. review.json overwritten with PENDING (old APPROVED copy = review.min-window.json). Nothing git add/commit/stash done.

MEASURED: rail outer 300 / inner 295 at 1280x720 and 1600x1000 (default); 240->235, 460->455. LEFT_RAIL_CHROME_PX = 5. Stored PanelState.size is now the OUTER width (Panel::show response rect). Under audit zoom 1.25/1.5 outer is 300 or 300.375 (physical-pixel rounding, within 0.5). Layers title-bar y = 337 (h 14, x 2..297) at BOTH 1280x720 and 1600x1000 at rail 300; info-settings 278, projects 527, snaps 219, builder-slot 675; sidebar rect y 23..721 at 720 tall so Layers is visible with scroll offset 0. Rail 240: layers y 377; rail 460: layers y 397 (still visible at 1280x720, projects 587). Left stack content height 821 (300), 989 (240), 893 (460) vs 698 viewport at 1280x720 -> stack scrolls/clips. 51 sidebar icons, all inside the sidebar x-range at 240/300/460; icon edges 18/22/34. In user-docked-right 1280x720 (Snaps right) layers y = 278 and right dock shows (right_dock_visible true); at lap125/lap150 the dock yields.

CMD ERROR: happens in DEFAULT mode too (lap150 1366x700 zoom 1.5 failed 3/3 before the fix with nothing docked right; lap125 passed once so it is flaky). ROOT CAUSE (proven with a per-pass trace): window smaller than the stored F6 float -> 'Command Search was moved back inside the window' is appended to the CMD history (note_dock_diagnostics -> Transcript::append_history) in the same frame as the first scripted Text; the stored CMD cursor then sits inside the protected history so Transcript::insert (index < protected_chars) drops Text('Line'); Enter then runs on an empty draft ('missing previous command') and later drafts never submit and concatenate. Focus was already true, so the plan's pure 'has focus' gate was NOT enough. Fix in ui.rs raw_input_hook: gate every default-script step (step <= 14) on CMD focus AND cursor == CCursorRange::one(char count of transcript); otherwise set focus_cmd, request_repaint, wait (max AUDIT_CMD_FOCUS_MAX_PASSES = 30 consecutive passes, then push 'FAILED audit CMD focus' once and continue). Pushes 'audit CMD focus ready' once; the 4 existing check strings are unchanged (receipt checks order: 'audit CMD focus ready','CMD line accepted once','actual CMD Undo','actual CMD Redo','Esc canceled draft without publication'). Real exe: lap125 (1366x680 z1.25) and lap150 (1366x700 z1.5) passed 5/5 each in default and user-docked-right mode, cmd has no 'unsupported'. Product caveat (not fixed, outside scope): a real user typing in the frame where a diagnostic is appended can hit the same stale-cursor drop.

FINAL NAMES / SIGNATURES
dock_layout.rs: LEFT_RAIL_MAX=460.; LEFT_RAIL_CHROME_PX: f32 = 5.; ICON_BASE_EDGE=22., ICON_MIN_EDGE=18., ICON_MAX_EDGE=34.; pub fn rail_icon_edge(outer_width: f32) -> f32 (clamp(22*w/300,18,34).round(), non-finite -> 22); pub const RIGHT_DOCK_FIXTURE: SectionId = SectionId::Snaps; pub const RIGHT_DROP_ZONE_WIDTH: f32 = 28.; RIGHT_DOCK_MAX still 420; NARROW_WINDOW_WIDTH still 1200. Header doc updated. New unit tests there: rail_icon_edge_hits_its_anchors_and_stays_monotone_and_clamped, widest_rail_and_widest_right_dock_still_leave_the_canvas_minimum, plus const asserts.
workbench_regions.rs: compile assert NARROW_WINDOW_WIDTH >= LEFT_RAIL_MAX + RIGHT_DOCK_MAX + CANVAS_MIN_WIDTH (was >); dead_notes_stay_unreachable extended (not weakened) to widest rail/dock and widths 1199/1200/1201.
ui.rs (MatrixApp pub fields): left_rail_outer_px: f32, right_dock_outer_px: f32 (0 while hidden), left_icon_edge: f32 (edge used in the left column last frame; NOTE the plan called it column_icon_edge for the receipt - private field column_icon_edge is the working value and is reset to ICON_BASE_EDGE after each column so toolbars stay 22), rail_icon_rects: Vec<Rect> (LEFT column icons only), right_dock_icon_rects: Vec<Rect> (separate vec so the two columns do not clobber each other - deviation from the plan's single vec), sidebar_content_size: Option<Vec2> (ScrollArea content_size), right_drop_zone_rect: Option<Rect>. Private: column_icon_edge, icon_column: IconColumn{None,Left,Right}, audit_layout_mode, audit_rail_width. pub enum AuditLayoutMode { Default, UserDockedRight } with .key() ('default'|'user-docked-right') and .label() ('Matrix-parity capture' | 'user-initiated OM9-extension layout, NOT a Matrix9 parity capture'); pub fn parse_audit_layout_mode(Option<&str>) -> Result<AuditLayoutMode, &'static str>; pub fn parse_audit_rail_width(&str) -> Option<f32> (finite, 240..=460). Existing accessors still: sidebar_rect, right_dock_rect, section_rect(key), section_rects, view_rects, regions, region_plan.
Env: OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK now FAILS launch ('OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK was replaced by OM9_UI_AUDIT_LAYOUT_MODE=user-docked-right'); OM9_UI_AUDIT_LAYOUT_MODE unset|default docks nothing, user-docked-right docks RIGHT_DOCK_FIXTURE, other value fails ('OM9_UI_AUDIT_LAYOUT_MODE must be default or user-docked-right'); OM9_UI_AUDIT_RAIL_WIDTH=<240..460> applied via dock.set_size before the first frame, never saved, bad value fails ('OM9_UI_AUDIT_RAIL_WIDTH must be a number from 240 to 460'). All four failure/ok paths were run against the real om9.exe.
Receipt (ui-receipt.json) dock.* NEW fields: section_title_bars_px {key:{x,y,w,h,column:'left'|'right'|'floating'|'top'|'bottom'|'unknown'}}, layers_rect_px (same shape or null), sidebar_scroll_offset, left_rail_outer_px, left_rail_inner_px, left_icon_edge_px, left_icon_count, left_icon_rects_in_sidebar (bool), left_stack_content_px [w,h]|null, right_dock_sections (== right_sections), right_dock_outer_px; existing right_dock_visible, left_sections, right_sections, floating_sections, left_rail_px, command_line_px, status_* kept. New top-level receipt.audit = {layout_mode, mode_label, rail_width_override}. dock_receipt(&self, &Context) is a private method (tested inside ui.rs tests); it is evaluated only when audit.awaiting_screenshot && !receipt_written.
Drop zone (chrome.rs): fn compute_right_drop_zone / pub(super) right_drop_zone_ui(ctx) (strip = last 28 pt of the union of view_rects, foreground overlay + 'Drop to dock right' label left of it, no reflow; only while section_drag is Some, pointer down, dock hidden and window >= 1200 pt); settle_section_drag: release inside zone -> dock_menu_section(id, Right); window < 1200 and pointer within 28 pt of the window right edge -> status 'Right dock needs a window at least 1200 points wide', nothing changes; window width/edge come from current_ui_context.content_rect(). Tests (chrome.rs): dragging_a_menu_to_the_right_edge_docks_it_and_shows_the_hidden_dock, a_window_under_1200_points_offers_no_drop_strip_and_docks_nothing.

FOR LATER STEPS (FEAT-002/003)
- A live egui panel remembers its size in egui memory, so app.dock.set_size(LeftRail, w) AFTER the first frame does NOT change the rendered width (default_size only applies to a fresh Context). Width tests must set the size on a fresh app BEFORE the first frame with a fresh egui::Context (this is how the measurements were taken), or call reset_menus(Some(&ctx)) first.
- Integration tests tests/{shell_docking,status_bar_overlap,workbench_regions_sizes,workbench_regions}.rs still dock Layers right (FEAT-002); all pass as-is. No integration test asserted the old inner 295.
- Validator (FEAT-003) must stop setting OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK (launch now fails), use OM9_UI_AUDIT_LAYOUT_MODE and OM9_UI_AUDIT_RAIL_WIDTH, expect the 5 checks incl. 'audit CMD focus ready', outer width 300 +-1 (300.375 under zoom 1.5), icon edge = round(clamp(22*outer/300,18,34)).
- The temporary measuring test was deleted; no other temp files remain (om9 temp dirs under %TEMP% removed).
